Severe headache, pulsation in temples, fulness and heavy aching on vertex ; she had her hair cut off to within two inches of scalp, because heaviness and heat of it almost distracted her ; pain < from least motion ; has not slept for three nights ; keeps eyes closed because light is disagreeable, though not painful ; tongue coated heavily on back part ; moderate thirst, putrid taste ; perspiration alternately with chilliness ; which causes her to cover herself up very heavily, till perspiration breaks out again ; oppressed breathing caused by sense of weight in chest, and occasional light cough ; pulse 106, small and empty ; hands hot ; aversion to food ; on attempting to rise, such weakness of limbs she could not stand.
θ Affection of brain.
Threatened meningeal inflammation. θ Yellow fever.
Bad consequences of cutting hair.
Rigidity of occipito-frontalis.
Head felt too large ; larger than usual ; enormously large. Constant inclination to throw head backward.
Flashes of lightning, sparks, mist or black spots before eyes.
Photophobia.
As if focus of right eye were suddenly displaced ; sees everything half light and half dark. Letters appear smaller.
Objects dance with every pulsation.
Sensation of whirling, of confused vision, of objects dancing before eyes.
Black spots before eyes during headache, especially when turning quickly.
Dim sight with vertigo, or fainting.
Pupils contracted. θ Sunstroke.
Pupils dilated ; eyes upturned ; sunstroke ; eyes rolled outwards and up ; convulsions. Eyes dull, staring, sunken.
Red injected eyes during headache ; reddened with wild expression.
Staring, wild look, protrusion of eyes.
Eyes very painful, bloodshot.
Face flushed, eyes inflamed.
Said her eyes were falling out.
Eyes feel as if some one were pulling them from within outward.
Drawing, pressing, aching, bursting pain in eyes ; soreness, quivering and twitching. In eyeballs : stitches ; twitchings ; soreness ; pressure ; pain as if protruding.
Pressing downward towards eyes.
Heat in eyeballs, lids and around eyes.
Beating over orbits.
Throbbing contracting the eyelids. Supra-orbital neuralgia ; pain usually commences at 6 A. M. and continues till 11 or 12. Pain under left eye.
Ringing in ears ; audible pulse.
Noise in left ear, as if it came from heart, every evening while reading, sometimes prevents falling asleep, but gets better during sleep.
Deafness, ears as if stopped up ; deafness followed by blurred vision. Heaviness, deafness, and sensation of being stopped up, in ears. Hardness of hearing.
Paralysis of auditory nerve.
Stitches in ears ; ears feel as if closed.
Throbbing piercing from within outward, in right ear.
Throbbing : above ears ; from occiput to ears.
Sensation of fulness in and around ears.
Ears red.
Pains in root of nose, headache extends to nose. Sudden sneezing ; fluent coryza.
Face flushed and very hot, especially about eyes and forehead, with headache.
Flushes of heat to face and head.
Heat in face with pulsations in head and palpitation.
Redness of face, especially upper part, with headache.
Unconscious with deep red or purple face.
Convulsions after delivery, with red face.
Face alternately flushed and pale.
Paleness of face with heat and congestion of blood to head and chest.
Paleness of face with congestion to head, in pregnant women.
Heat of face, with pallor and sleepiness.
Pale face : in sunstroke ; after sweating.
Yellowish-redness of face during sunstroke.

Faceache : muscles twitch, even unconsciousness ; breathing stertorous ; < in heat of bed. Sudden neuralgic pains from decayed tooth, concentrating in temple ; head heavy, but cannot lay it on pillow.
Periodical attacks of facial neuralgia.
Tic douloureux, left side of face.
Sweat on face.
Cold sweat on face during congestion to head.
Itching, especially in middle of face.
Convulsions with frothing at mouth.
Burning in various small places on lips.
Lower lip feels swollen.
Numbness in lower lip ; sensation as if swollen.

Strange sensation in chin ; it feels as if it were being elongated to knees ; was obliged to put his hand to his chin repeatedly, to convince himself that it was not the case ; prover had considerably jarred and injured his chin by a fall twenty years before.
Special action on masseter muscles, region of mastoid process, and head.
Gnawing sensation in masseter muscles.
Pain and stiffness of articulation of jaw.
Jaws firmly clenched. θ Sunstroke.
Throbbing pain in all the teeth.
Pulsating toothache with headache.
Pulsating, throbbing pains ; teeth feel elongated.

Toothache from taking cold, after having been over-heated ; beating of pulse felt in all the teeth, or a drawing ; pain extending to whole right side of face, having waves of spontaneous exacerbation, without being influenced by anything in particular.

Toothache ; after hitting, in chewing a hard substance, a bad tooth, a pain extends from that tooth into whole row of teeth, into whole right lower jaw and cheek, and here especially in nervus infra orbitalis, also into right ear, temple and parietal bone ; pain is continual, with sudden spasmodic exacerbations ; it has no rhythm, nor is it influenced by cold or warm air, rest or motion ; gums swollen and sensitive to touch.
Pain in decayed teeth, left side, after falling asleep ; pain felt only at night, awakens her ; malar. bone sore to touch ; pain under left eye and on side of neck.

Rooting pain in one upper and one lower molar tooth, right side ; both were carious ; they feel longer, the gums are swollen ; pain extends into right temple, ear and parietal bone ; nothing seems to influence the pain. θ Toothache.
Sudden pain from decayed inferior molar, concentrates in temple.
Severe pain from decayed tooth, lasting several hours.
Stabbing pain in gums, right side passing to left, without ceasing in right ; < from hot, > from cold applications.
Teeth decay : after mercury ; catamenia scanty ; following exposure to sun.
Taste : bitter, with nausea ; aromatic ; sweet ; warm ; leaves fatty taste.
Tongue milk-white, without coating ; violent headache ; wants head pressed or bound ; cannot eat ; very weak and miserable.
Tongue coated heavily on back part ; putrid taste. θ Brain affection.
Tongue feels swelled and raw, with spasmodic twitchings. Tongue numb, as if burnt ; prickling, stinging. Difficulty in conversing, from diminished power of tongue and confusion of ideas.
Saliva increased, slimy.
Froth about mouth ; convulsions.
Sensation of soreness and swelling on roof of mouth, with pulsation.
Soft palate : dry ; feels as if drawn up.
Itching of soft palate and throat.
Swollen sensation in fauces.
Throat feels as if swelling ; full sensation in both sides of neck. Constriction at top of larynx ; in throat, as if throttled. Tickling, heat and soreness in throat.
Coated tongue, no appetite. 0 Sunstroke.
Wants cold water ; also from dry, parched feeling.
Increased desire to smoke.
Wine aggravates all symptoms. Alcoholic stimulants cause delirium, congestion, stupor, etc.
Nausea ; with congestion ; and retching, during sunstroke ; with faint feeling ; causing sweat, which relieves.
Nausea with, and caused by, headache, with colic ; congestion of blood to head and chest, and pale face.
Faint, warm, sickening sensation in chest and stomach, resembling threatening of seasickness ; also slight giddiness, especially on moving about.
Vomiting : spasmodic, in hydrocephalus ; in sunstroke.
Sea-sickness.
Gnawing in epigastrium.
Attack begins suddenly with violent pain in epigastrium. Sensation of emptiness in pit of stomach.
Faint feeling at pit of stomach ; also with throbbing there. Sensitiveness of pit of stomach, especially on stooping.
Pain in pit of stomach, as if sore, when touched ; < when stooping. Respiration labored ; pit of stomach the seat of distress. θ Sunstroke. Dull, heavy pain in stomach.
Stomach and head feel as if he had been out in hot sun.
Pain in left hypochondrium, half-way between pit of stomach and side.
Rumbling in bowels, belching, passing offensive flatus. Cutting, mostly below navel (wakens one in morning). Venous congestion to abdomen.
Stools : loose, scanty, with much rumbling ; copious, loose, dark, lumpy, with colic, heat in anus, nausea and sudden urging.
Diarrheic stools with rumbling and discharges of flatus, beginning in morning and lasting all day.
Diarrhea, with sudden cessation of menses.
Frequent passage of flatus during stools, with a loud, sharp noise.
Inclined to be costive.
After 10 in evening, an unaccustomed time, a hard and unusual stool, pinching in abdomen before and after it, till going to sleep.
Urine : abundant, highly albuminous ; must rise often at night to pass it ; high-colored, burning while passing ; with red sediment and muddy, reddish-yellow slime.
During menstruation : congestion of blood to head and chest ; headache ; fainting.
Menstrual period three days every six weeks, accompanied by lumbar pain ; pupils dilated ; < at night ; some relief from hot fomentations.
Catamenia had not appeared for six weeks ; throbbing pains through temples and pressure and heaviness on head ; feels sick ; constipation ; restless at night.
Intense congestion of brain induced in plethoric constitutions by sudden suppression of menses, or appearing in place of the menses.
Disturbances in intercranial circulation at time of menopause.
Instead of menses : headache ; congestion to head ; pale face : < in warm room, > when walking in cold air ; diarrhoea ; fainting.

Before, during, or at end of menstruation, or when it does not appear at all, fulness in head, with or without redness of face and eyes, especially with throbbing, sometimes with excessive tearing, throbbing pains.
Headaches occurring after profuse uterine hemorrhage.
Flushings to head during climacteric period.

During climacteric : flushes of heat daily in frequent attacks, with pressure in head, nausea, loss of senses ; cannot go alone in street ; vertigo ; swelling and numbness in feet. Since first menstruation, congestion to head, with loss of consciousness ; face became deep red or purple color ; hands clenched, thumbs thrown into the palms ; froth before mouth ; attacks became more frequent and severe, so that instead of appearing only at times of menstruation, they had for several years occurred three or four times in twenty-four hours ; menstruation scanty, constant fear of attack ; < from mental or physical effort ; after attack, palpitation violent, subsiding after an hour ; constant sensation of tremulousness in cardiac region ; pulse quick, small, irregular ; heart's impulse increased, action rapid, irregular and tumultuous, blending of first and second sounds, so that they were indistinguishable ; numbness in left extremities.
During pregnancy : headache ; congestion of blood to head and chest.

Rush of blood to head in pregnant women, especially with paleness of face, loss of consciousness, falling down insensible, sometimes with cold sweat, especially in face. Face bright red, unconsciousness, extraordinary full, quick pulse ; strikes about her with hands and feet, can scarcely be kept in bed, throws herself wildly about, foams at mouth, eyeballs roll convulsively about, or stare straight in front, or are drawn upwards, convulsions last four or five minutes, during intervals turns about restlessly in bed ; violent throbbing of heart and carotids. 9 Convulsions after labor.
Eclampsia : unconscious ; face bright red ; puffed ; pulse full, hard ; urine copious and albuminous.

sections.h: Voice And Larynx. Trachea And Bronchia
p: Acute irritation of cerebral nerves, vertigo ; slight bronchial irritation with frequent expectoration of thick mucus. @ Laryngo-tracheitis.
Breathing : heavy, labored, stertorous ; oppressed from feeling of weight ; accelerated ; must often breathe deeply ; sighing.
Sensation of constriction and oppression of chest, with perceptible palpitation, compelling to draw deep breath.
Oppressed breathing, caused by sense of weight in chest ; occasional light cough.
θ Affection of brain.
Constriction of chest ; chest feels as if laced.
Pain in chest like tension, and frequent inclination to deep respiration. Oppression of chest alternating with headache.
Congestion alternating between chest and head.
Sinking feeling in head and chest, as from working in hot room. Sensation of flying heat, rising from chest to face and head.
Sharp, cutting pains across shoulder-blades to anterior part of chest. Numb sensation moving upwards in chest and down left arm.
Sharp pains in the heart.
Fulness in the heart.
Violent action of heart, distinct pulsation over whole body.
Violent palpitation of heart, with throbbing carotids, pulsating headache in forehead and between temples.

Violent palpitation ; constant tremulous sensation in cardiac region ; heart's impulse increased ; pulse quick, small.

Palpitation of heart with heat in face, accelerated pulse and pulsation of carotid arteries. Heart's action easily excited ; violent palpitation, throbbing carotids, pulsating headache ; < stooping.
Laborious action of heart ; oppression ; frequent pulse.
Pressure in heart, as if it was being contracted.

In heart sensation of fulness, heaviness and heat, with labored beating of heart.
Blood seems to rush to heart and mount rapidly into head.
Alternate congestion to heart and to head.
Sharp pains in heart.
Severe stitches from heart extending into back, between shoulders.
Anxiety in precordia ; weakness.

Blending of first and second sounds so that they were indistinguishable.
Accelerated pulse ; beats increased.

Pulse full, slow and intermittent. θ Sunstroke.

Pulse mostly accelerated, often changing suddenly to slow and back again.
Pulse : irregular, intermitting ; quick, small, irregular, with violent action of heart ; small and
rapid ; weak and slow ; low and feeble, in sunstroke.
Arteries in head become distinct.
Throbbing of carotid arteries, both seen and felt.
Temporal and carotid arteries beating violently.

Plethoric female had, since she began to menstruate, attacks of blood to head alternately with rush of blood to heart, with pale or red face, five or six times in day ; at same time she lost her consciousness and fell down ; alternate palpitation and cerebral congestion, with loss of consciousness, convulsions and foam before mouth.
As an intercurrent remedy in angina pectoris, to prevent the organism from getting accustomed to the influence of Aur. mur.
Sweat on the chest.
The neck feels weak and tired, cannot support the head.

On neck sensation of fulness, tension, pulsation.
Nape of neck stiff, with headache.
When throwing back his head, he felt a pain like cramp in back of his neck, to the felt, in region of sixth and seventh cervical vertebre.
Sensitiveness and pain in occiput, upper back and upper chest, coming on a few months after violent jarring from being thrown from a carriage.
Severe neuralgic pain in lower part of cervical region of spine and right arm.
Sharp cutting across scapulze.

Pain down entire spine, after constriction in chest ; shiverings downward.
Old contusions and jars.

Pain from shoulder to back of right hand.

Hands clenched, thumbs thrown into palms. θ Convulsions.
Beating of pulse is perceptible in all fingers.
Trembling of fingers.
Rheumatic pains in fingers of left hand.

Jerking of limbs with loss of consciousness.
Limbs relaxed and motionless. θ Sunstroke.
Thighs weak during headache.
Weakness and numbness of thigh.
Unsteady gait.
Weakness of legs, knees and ankles give way.
The knees give (when getting up from bed) on account of headache ; weakness of kneejoints afterwards for an hour.
Knocking of knees and thighs together during headache.
Acute pain in left knee on moving, seemed to be deep in joint, without much heat or swelling ; sudden twinges or pricks, while at rest, is obliged to rise and straighten limb. θ Acute rheumatism.
Cold feet, with nausea, palpitation.
Great weakness in middle portion of thighs and arms. Sensation of weakness and trembling in limbs. Extremities feel bloated.
Sharp pricking pain in arms and legs.
Numbness in left extremities.
While at rest pain in knee <, must rise and straighten limb.
When lying down sensation as if neck were grasped.
Lying still : > headache.
Lying : on back or side causes "pillow to beat ;" purring noise in region of heart. Lying on left side : purring in region of heart.
After lying down : headache <.
Must have his head elevated.
Cannot lay head on pillow, head is so heavy.
Sitting still : > headache.
Sitting up : vertigo <.
Bending head backwards : < headache.
Bends head forward : from heaviness.

Using eyes : < headache.
Restlessness in limbs causes him to rise.

Ascending steps : headache <.

Attempts to spring from window.
Runs about room : with headache.
Romping : causes headache.
Feeling as after inhaling ether.
Restlessness in limbs, must rise and walk.
Feeling as after fright, not mental, but bodily.
Sensation as of throbbing throughout body, with heat and sweat.
Painless pulsation all over body ; circulation easily quickened.
Feeling of fulness throughout body.
Pulsations, tingling, thrills, and a peculiar sensation of warmth through body, extending from above downward.
Weakness as from loss of sleep.
Feeling of prostration. θ Sunstroke.
Unconscious falling down, or fainting with consciousness.

Convulsions : epileptiform, cerebral congestion, scanty or suppressed menses ; hands clenched, thumbs in palms, face red, eyes rolled upward, then sopor ; left-sided, with fingers spread ; face alternately red and pale ; each attack occurs regularly every three hours, begins suddenly with violent pain in epigastrium, upward in chest and down left arm, with uterine derangement. θ Convulsions.

Strong, healthy-looking child subject to convulsions at intervals of a few months ; attacks preceded by drowsiness, soon after which child fell into a convulsive state, with clenching and jerking upward of fists and legs ; face red ; eyes rolled outward and upward ; then followed a soporific condition, lasting several hours, followed by another convulsion. Great congestion of head and heart ; during spasms he spreads his fingers and toes asunder.
Convulsions, especially left fingers spread apart.
Convulsions after mental or physical effort.
Epileptic attacks with aura epileptica.
Epileptiform attack in young lady et. 20 ; congestion to head, loss of consciousness, jerking of limbs ; no foam at mouth ; dysmenorrhea with scanty menstruation.
Epileptic convulsions with congestion to head and heart.
Unable to speak, although usually a very noisy child ; mouth drawn to left side ; cannot protrude tongue in a straight line.
Loss of power to articulate, also has no memory for words. θ Aphasia.
Effects of alcoholic stimulants, intoxication, delirium tremens, congestions, sleepiness and subsequent depression.
Spasmodic and neuralgic affections.
Drowsy, yawning ; inclination to deep inspiration ; face hot and pale. Yawning with headache, congestion of blood to head.
Sleepiness early in evening.
Restless sleep ; awakes with fear of apoplexy.
Sleepless.
Dreams : confused ; of homesickness, with tears ; of comical heads. Difficult to awaken.
Worse morning and forenoon : headache, languor, colic.
Worse afternoon and evening : headache ; diarrhoea.
Morning : on rising, vertigo ; throbbing in head < ; congestion to head ; vertigo ; cutting pains below navel wakes one : diarrheic stools.

From 6 A. M. until 11 or 12 : supra-orbital neuralgia.
After 10 in evening : a hard, unusual stool.
Night : pain in decayed teeth ; must rise to pass urine, lumbar pains < ; restless.
Children get sick in the night after sitting opposite an open coal fire, or falling asleep there. Bad effects from having the hair cut.
Bad effects from being exposed inordinately to the sun's rays. Open air : vertigo < ; headache with unconsciousness >.

Overheating : causes headache.

Cannot walk in sun nor bear heat from stove.
Rays of sun cannot be borne on head.
Bad results from sunstroke.

Cold water : < headache ; causes spasms ; > congestive headache.

Chill : after getting heated ; alternates with sweat ; with vomiting ; head as if screwed up ; in intermittent fever.
Chill after getting heated ; drawing pain and heat in head, vertigo, buzzing in ears, flushed face.
Perspiration alternately with chilliness, which causes her to cover herself up very heavily, till perspiration breaks out again. # Affection of brain.
Flushes of heat ; waves of heat upward.
Heat, especially in face, ascending from pit of stomach to head.
As if warm water were running upward from nape of neck.
Sensation of warmth throughout body.
Fever heat, and small, quick pulse. θ Sunstroke.

Typhoid fever ; very violent headache ; wants head squeezed ; tongue is not furred, but as white as milk ; can't eat, feels weak and miserable.

All day : attacks of headache ; congestion to head ; diarrheic stools.

Every 12 or 15 days : attacks of headache.

Right : stitches in temple and forehead ; focus of eyes displaced ; piercing, throbbing in ear ; toothache, lower jaw and cheek ; neuralgic pain in arm ; pain from shoulder to back of hand. Sore pain on left side of tongue when moving it.
Whitish, painful ulcer on lower surface of tongue.
Burning blisters on lower side and tip of tongue.
Painful vesicles and tubercles on back part of tongue.
Rotten odor from mouth and gums.
Acid, foul odor from mouth.
Breath smells like urine.
Saliva increased, much spitting.
Saliva runs from mouth in morning on stooping. Dryness of mouth in morning.
Palate : feels sore.
Palate and fauces somewhat reddened. θ Deafness.
Violent catarrh in fauces, with sensation as though food had to pass over a lump in throat ; roughness and rawness in throat ; hoarseness in evening. 9 Ozzena scrofulosa.
Swelling of tonsils, with pain when swallowing.
Ulcerative pain in throat.
Roughness and rawness in throat.
Hawking of phlegm ; throat seems full of gurgling mucus.
Sensation on left side of throat as though he had to swallow over an elevation, with scraping in it.
On swallowing sensation of lump in throat, and especially on empty swallowing a constrictive retching from oesophagus up to larynx.
Constant spasm in throat, obliging him to swallow as if he were choking, as if food would not go down.
Constant cramp in throat, causing him to retch, as if the food would not go down.
Nightly pains in throat like a plug, as if the food filled him to the top.
Excessive hunger.
Canine hunger with acidity of stomach.
Appetite excessive or wanting, with much thirst, or with fulness of abdomen. Violent thirst, early in morning.
Desire for drink to cool one's self internally, without thirst.
Aversion : to animal food, when thinking of it ; to fish ; to cooked food. Great aversion to salt.
Sweet things are disgusting and nauseous.
Worse when hungry.
Food will not go down.
Pains in stomach necessitate eating.
Is obliged to eat on account of burning in stomach.
Must quickly eat a piece of bread, to > suffocative paroxysm. Hot things disagree with the stomach.
Abdomen becomes inflated after eating.
Hiccough after meals.
Eructations : sour ; bitter or sour green water ; putrid ; tasting of the food eaten ; > pressure in stomach ; constant ; ineffectual ; while walking.

Cramp in stomach, with nausea, collection of water in mouth in such quantities that she cannot speak, but has to keep the mouth open ; vertigo, at times has neuralgia of face (region of os zygomaticum), and intense headache (clavus) ; during first day of menses cramp-pain in legs, costiveness, cold feet.
Rancid heartburn, particularly after eating.
Qualmishness, as from abdomen, with contractive pain below umbilicus, and much mucus in throat, especially in morning, and for several hours after a meal.

Nausea : and vertigo ; and sweat, with anxiety ; like faintness, preventing sleep : with spasm in throat ; with eructations ; with headache ; with inclination to vomit ; and sour vomiting ; in morning ; after eating.
Nausea, in morning, with weakness and trembling during day, during menstruation. Vomiting : of all food taken ; with pressure in stomach ; sour ; of food.
Vomiting, purging, and icy-cold sweat, with headache.
Sickening, painful feeling at pit of stomach.
Insipid and ''spoiled'' sensation in stomach, though a good appetite.
Pressure in pit of stomach : whole forenoon, > by eructation ; night and morning. Binding, constricting pain in gastric region.
Constrictive pain in stomach.
Sensation of lump in stomach, with constant beating, as of two hammers. θ Hysteria.
Pain in stomach : necessitates eating ; > from warm milk, < from boiled meat and cold drinks.
Nightly pinching pain in stomach and rooting pain in chest.
Griping in stomach, with flatulency.
Griping in stomach, with nausea ; she was constantly obliged to spit, as in water-brash. Fulness in stomach and abdomen.
Burning in stomach, causing hunger.

Crampy, spasmodic, or clawing pains, or pressure, with vomiting of ingesta, > by lying down, and warmth of bed, returning when rising, with vomiting ; acidity ; constipation ; pain in hepatic region ; > from warm food or drinks ; nervous cardialgia, with anemia ; chlorotic color of face ; dysmenorrheea ; herpetic constitution.

Gastralgia a few hours after dinner ; < by cold drinks and boiled meats ; > by warm milk ; furry taste ; pain is to left of stomach and great severity, with absence of usual gastric symptoms as acidity, water-brash, nausea, vomiting ; constant yawning with bloatedness of gastric region. θ Chlorosis.
Periodical gastralgia with vomiting of food immediately after eating ; the pains are burning and radiate into abdomen.
Gastrodynia with anemia ; chlorotic color of face ; dysmenorrheea ; constipation ; irritability.
Cardialgia or gastric catarrh ; in women during climacteric period.
Chronic catarrh of stomach, with frequent eructations ; frequently feels faint with partial loss of senses.
Chronic gastritis, with thirst, especially after abuse of alcoholic drinks.
Stitches in both hypochondria.
Hardness in region of liver.
Burning in left hypochondrium, internally, < when lying on it. Cannot bear tight clothing around hypochondria.
Cutting, bearing down pains in hypochondria and hips.
Pain in upper abdomen, as if everything would be torn to pieces during menstruation. Cramp in lower abdomen. ? Dysmenorrhea.
Pain below navel, as if intestines were torn.
Burning pains radiating through abdomen. θ Gastralgia.
Burning in a small spot on left side of abdomen.
Pain in belly, in left side, when lying on right, and vice versa.
Stitches in left side of abdomen.
Colic immediately after eating.
Griping, digging pains in abdomen.
Zona ; large blisters on raised ground, from umbilicus to spine ; all blisters opened by scratching ; excruciating burning.
Rumbling in abdomen.
Croaking, as of frogs, in abdomen.
Cannot endure anything tight about abdomen after eating.
Heaviness in abdomen.
Distension of abdomen, with rush of blood to head, heaviness of head, vertigo and confusion.
Great distension of abdomen, with dulness and heaviness of head.
Distended abdomen : after eating ; with diarrhcea.
Abdomen tense, with menses delaying, scanty and pale.
Abdomen distended, tense, hard.
Hardness in lower part of abdomen.
Full abdomen, as from accumulation and incarceration of flatus ; she cannot bear anything tight about hypochondria.
Incarcerated flatus, painfully pressing towards groins and anus.
First two after birth, colic, arising from excessive accumulation of inodorous gas ; during paroxysm of pain, which occurs mostly in evening, child throws itself back and straightens body.
Flatulence suddenly appears and presses painfully towards abdominal ring.
Passage of much offensive flatus, which constantly collects anew.
Griping in abdomen every time before passage of flatus.
(Edema of external abdomen ;

Ascites progressing steadily and apparently to a fatal termination ; great accumulation of serum in abdominal cavity, and great oedema of extremities, chiefly lower, which were elephantine in size ; profuse and constant watery exudation from skin below knees ; epidermis exfoliated ; exudation glutinous in character.
Ascites in conjunction with moist tetter, with glutinous exudation. θ Herpes zoster. Itching of abdomen.
Pain in inguinal regions.
Swelling and great sensitiveness of one inguinal gland.
Herpetic eruption in groins.
Glandular swellings in groins.
Excessive discharge of flatus.
Frequent discharge of offensive flatus, with distension of abdomen.
Stools brown, fluid, mixed with undigested substances, and of an intolerable fetor. Thin, scalding stools, light brown.
Diarrhea, almost without colic, followed by great prostration, of short duration. Watery stools.
Mucous diarrhea.
Continuous soft stools of too small a size.
Chronic softness of stool.
Stool pasty, like mud, adhering to vessel.
A quantity of white mucus is expelled with the stool, or the hard feces are covered with slime.
Stools knotty, the lumps being united by mucous threads ; even after stool there is still mucus coming from anus.
Much inclination to stool ; though not hard, still it is evacuated with much exertion, on account of total inactivity of rectum.
Constipation ; stool large, knotty.
Feces very large and difficult of passage.
Hard stool, with much urging and sticking in anus.
Constipation from hardened stool or from inactivity of bowels ; stools knotty and large. Obstinate constipation and delayed menstruation occur together.
Hard, lumpy stool, with slime and blood. θ Hemorrhoids.

Sensation of heaviness in abdomen ; chronic constipation with hardness in region of liver ; hard, knotty stool, with pain in hemorrhoids and discharge of mucus and blood ; prolapsus of rectum without any urging to stool, as if anus were paralyzed ; menses late ; thin, watery leucorrhea.

Constipation with dryness of mucous membrane of rectum and fissure of anus. Constipation in women who are inclined to erysipelatous inflammation and ulcerative processes of lower extremities on a rheumatic basis, and who are of a timid, morose and dejected disposition.
Constipation in subjects of herpetic diathesis or with scrofulous cachexia ; in hypochondriacal subjects with marked abdominal symptoms.
Constipation ; menses irregular ; a cough and a fixed pain in left side, just above cardiac region ; she was dejected and had lost her natural vivacity and spirits.
Stools : rarely diarrheic and then usually painless : purging and vomiting, with icy-cold sweat ; insufficient ; hard, lumpy, with slime and blood.
Sour-smelling stool with burning at rectum.
Stools very thin, like a round worm.
During stool : burning in rectum ; tenesmus.
With the stool discharge of a little blood ; of tape-worm.
After stool : smarting and soreness in anus ; much mucus remains about anus ; great but transient prostration.
Prolapsus of rectum with its hemorrhoids, even without urging to stool, as if anus had lost its contractility and was paralyzed.
Easy prolapse of rectum, as though parts had lost their tonicity ; it becomes prolapsed without even a desire for stool.
Discharge of mucus from rectum.

Piles of twelve years' duration, with frequent attacks of hemorrhage, which caused anemia ; she was daily getting weaker from loss of blood and restless nights ; pulse low and feeble ; rectum partially prolapsed with two filbert-shaped piles, as large as little finger, knotty and fissured, from which a sanious fluid oozed with an odor like that which is characteristic of cancer.
Hemorrhoids of rectum, with burning rhagades at anus.
Hemorrhoids, with pain on sitting down, or on taking a wide step as if split with a knife, also violent itching, and very sore to touch.
Varices feel very sore after an evacuation ; painful burning fissures between varices. Large hemorrhoidal tumors.
Fissura ani ; severe, sharp, cutting pain during stool, followed by constriction and aching
for several hours, < at night.
Severe pain during evacuation, sharp, cutting, followed by constriction and aching for several hours, and especially severe at night. θ Fissures of anus.

Burning and bleeding during stool ; pressure and burning and sharp, cutting stitches in anus ; soreness at anus, and smarting on contact ; bleeding from rectum, with sharp, stitching pains ; prolapsus ani, with sensation as though sphincter had lost its contractile power and was paralyzed. θ Fissures of anus.
Hemorrhoids in anus, causing burning.
Swelling of anus.
Cutting and stitches in anus.
Smarting, sore pain in anus on wiping it.
Itching of anus.
Tape-worm.
Cutting and downward pressure in both kidneys before urinating.
Anxious pressure in bladder, with sudden desire to urinate, but scanty emission. Frequent urination, particularly at night.
rging to urinate, with scanty discharge.
rging to urinate, with dribbling after the usual discharge.
rine clear, but after four or five hours, covered with an iridescent film. rine becomes turbid and deposits a white sediment.
rine becomes very turbid after two hours, with reddish sediment ; biting in urethra while assing it.
Urine : dark brown ; fetid ; sour.
Stitches or smarting in urethra when urinating.
Urinary troubles, with burning in urethra between acts of micturition.
Very thin stream of urine, as if urethra were contracted.
Pain in sacrum or coccygis when urinating.
Nocturnal enuresis.

Uncontrollable sexual excitement ; violent erections.
Voluptuous irritability of genitals.
Tension and lascivious feeling in genitals.
Revival of sexual desire and fantasies.
Pollutions with weakness and pain in sacrum ; neuralgic pains in back of neck.

Seminal emissions at night, with flaccid penis ; they wake him, but no voluptuous feelings ; sensation of great weakness in genitals ; costiveness ; from previous sexual abuse. Emissions with amorous dreams.

Sexual weakness, consisting of lively desire with incomplete erection and too rapid or too early discharge of semen, such as sometimes follows the habit of masturbation, acquired in boyhood and abandoned early.
Almost involuntary emission, without much erection, during an embrace.
Sexual debility from sexual abuse.
Decided aversion to coition.
Impotence, with dislike to coition.
Want of proper sensation during coition.
Painful cramps in calves during an embrace.
No ejaculation follows coition in spite of every exertion.
After an embrace coldness of legs, exhaustion, heat of body and perspiration.
Dropsical swelling of prepuce and scrotum.
Herpetic eruptions on penis.
Prepuce swells to a large water blister without pain.
Vesicular eruption on prepuce.
Testes swollen.
Hydrocele (I. side), herpetic eruption on scrotum, in groins, or on lower extremities either preceding or accompanying the disease, or when arising from suppression of cutaneous disease.
Itching and moist eruption on scrotum.
Itching on scrotum.
Gonorrheea.

Stricture of urethra with sudden arrest of flow, then oozing of snuff-colored slime in a long thread, or, instead, a few drops of bloody water ; after micturition sudden peremptory urging near glans, or seems to run back when costive.
Gluey, sticky discharge at meatus urinarius, blocking up urethra. θ Gleet.
Great aversion to coitus.
Enlarged ovaries, which become more tender and more enlarged every time she takes cold or gets her feet damp.
Swelling and hardness of ovaries after menses.

Tearing, grinding, twisting pains in right ovary, as if it would burst, before or during menses. The indurated left ovary swells and becomes very hard ; violent pains on touch, respiration or hawking, when violent stitches shoot into it ; profuse general sweat ; continual loss of sleep.

Tumors, size of an orange, in right iliac fossa, also similar one in left ; both hard, round, slightly movable ; not painful to pressure, nor producing inconvenience from weight. Bearing down pain in uterus to back, with weakness and sickness. θ Dysmenorrhea.
Pain in uterus when reaching high with arms.
Os uteri standing backwards, can only be reached with difficulty.
Cauliflower excrescences ; cancer uteri ; severe lancinating, stitching pains through uterus down to lower extremities ; heaviness of abdomen with increased pain when standing.

Hot and painful vagina ; swelling of lymphatic vessels and mucous follicles ; neck of uterus hard and swollen, with tuberculous nodes and cauliflower excrescences ; great weight in abdomen on rising, with fainting sort of weakness and < of pains ; delaying menses, with < of pains shortly before and at appearance of menses ; discharge of black, lumpy, fetid blood ; stitches shooting through abdomen as far as thighs ; burning and stitching pains ; constipation ; livid complexion ; sad and anxious mood. θ Cancer uteri.
Bearing down pain in womb, with weakness and sinking ; pain over eyes ; pain in middle of nee _ cou: th, scraping, | ness and soreness. θ D oe

Lassitude and heaviness in lower extremities, and chronic hoarseness, a forerunner of tuberculosis ; no menses for three months.
Menostasi
Anemia, with dryness of vagina.
First menses delayed.

Instead of regular period has leucorrheea and suffers with constipation ; has grown very fat ; as a child had tettery eruption on both forearms, of which, however, no trace is left. (Edema pedum from amenorrhea.
Before and during menstruation fatiguing cough.
Before and during menses cough throughout day, fatiguing chest ; no cough at night. Leucorrheic discharge occurs in gushes day or night.
Pain in epigastrium during catamenia, as if everything would be torn to pieces, with laborlike pains ; persistent and stinging toothache. θ Dysmenorrhea.

During menses : dry cough and profuse sweats, morning sickness, swelling of feet and painless swelling of face ; hoarseness, violent coryza and catarrhal fever ; colic ; violent headache with nausea ; morning sickness ; chaffing between legs ; swelling of feet ; chilliness ; pain in varices ; hoarseness with dry cough, headache evenings ; painless swelling of cheeks ; colic-like labor pains ; backache ; heat in abdomen ; urging, pressing, like labor pains ; itching in abdomen ; weakness in feet, that she cannot walk ; pain in abdomen ; growing dark before eyes.

After menses, jerking in arms ; at other times ; pain below navel, as if intestines were torn ; lying upon right side, pain is in left, and vice versa ; reaching with arms high, pain in region of womb ; constipation.
Lassitude and weakness with the catamenia.
Morning sickness of pregnancy or during menses.
Vagina cold. θ Chlorosis.
Biting or smarting in vagina.
Vesicles or excoriations in vagina. θ Pruritus.
Itching, smarting, painful vesicle on vulva ; itching pimples on vulva.
Itching vesicles and pimples on labia, which smart and are painful ; painless pimples on inside of labia.
Painful pressure towards pudenda.
Itching of pudenda before menstruation.
Excoriations in perineum, vulva and between thighs.
Soreness between thighs, near pudenda, during menstruation.
Feeling of external irritation at genitals as if the parts were swollen.
(dema of pudenda. θ Chlorosis.

Acrid, excoriating leucorrheea, in gushes, day and night, before and after menses. Profuse leucorrheea, with weakness of back and sacrum, when walking and sitting. Yellowish-white leucorrhea, excoriating skin ; uterus indurated, swollen and sore ; straining in anus, with protruding piles, and bearing down in bowels long after an evacuation.

Leucorrhea ; profuse, perfectly white, especially on rising in morning ; weakness of back when walking or sitting, with distension of abdomen, and painful pressure towards pudenda ; discharges occur in gushes day and night ; turbid urine ; frequent micturition, especially at night ; difficult stool ; great lassitude.
Copious, thin leucorrhea, causing a biting, smarting sensation in vagina.
During climaxis : cardialgia ; gastric catarrh.
Tendency to obesity. θ Uterine complaints.
Large and corpulent women of venous constitution, who are subject to tettery eruptions, which itch and emit glutinous fluid.
Labor pains weak or have ceased entirely.
Nipples painful and cracked.
Sore nipples of nursing women, end of nipple cracked and fissured, exuding a limpid serum.
Hard cicatrices remaining after mammary abscess, retarding flow of milk.
Cancer of mamma, from old cicatrices, which had remained after repeated abscesses.

sections.h: Voice And Larynx. Trachea And Bronchia
p: Voice : impaired ; not clear, in singing ; cracked, in singing. Hoarseness in evening. @ Coryza.
Chronic hoarseness.
Soreness and roughness of larynx, with tickling cough.
Laryngeal region sensitive to touch.
Respiration has a dry sound.
Constriction of chest, as if about to suffocate when falling asleep.
Constriction of the chest, as if too narrow.

Suffocative paroxysm at night, awakens him out of sleep, usually after midnight, must quickly jump out of bed, hold himself firmly to something, and quickly eats whatever is on hand, which gives relief ; very hoarse cough. θ Asthma spasmodicum.
Cough, caused by taking a deep inspiration in evening and at night.
Cough : caused by deep inspiration ; loose, from tickling deep in chest.
Cough at night.

Whooping-cough with strangling, red face, watery eyes ; strains all over ; sometimes wind comes from anus ; raises phlegm ; morning much hard coughing, throat feels full of gurgling mucus ; impudent, teasing ; laughs at reprimands ; several hard straining small stools daily.
Expectoration : salty ; day and evening.
Cramps of chest.
Pains in chest.
Pain in middle of chest, with cough, scraping, rawness and soreness. Raw pain in chest, like raw flesh.
Stitching pains in chest.
Stitches in chest and palpitation of heart from least exercise.
Region of heart : constriction ; pressure ; stitches.
Sensation like an electric shock, from heart toward front of neck.
Strong pulsation of blood in whole body, but especially about heart, < by every motion. Palpitation of heart ; with anxiety ; with nosebleed.
Pulse full and hard, somewhat accelerated in morning, slow during day and evening.
Stinging in fleshy part of chest.
Pimples and herpes on chest.
Zona on left side, with pain in thoracic muscles on motion.
Itching vesicles and restlessness at night.
Perspiration on sternum every morning.
Nipples painful and cracked.
(In sick :) Aching soreness and bleeding of male nipples.

Soreness of nipples, with small, corrosive blisters or ulcers, oozing a limpid serum, or a thick, glutimous fluid, which forms a crust that is removed by nursing, when the same formation again occurs, and so on ; disposition to fissure and crack.
Small bluish blisters on nipple, with fluid discharge.
Threatened suppuration, when breasts are marked with many cicatrices from former ulcerations.
Hard scars remaining after mammary abscesses.
Mammary cancer developed from old cicatrices formed from repeated abscesses in mamma.
Pain in nape of neck.
Stiffness of back of neck ; also with headache.
Glands on side of neck down to shoulder, swollen and painful when bending neck to one side, or lying upon it ; as if tense and stiff.
Glandular swellings on left side of neck.
Painless swollen glands on side of neck.
Small boils on neck, back and arms.
Eruption on nape of neck dry, peeling in fine, mealy scales, without itching.

Chronic eruption on scalp and nape of neck ; falling out of hair ; dandruff ; terrible itching and burning ; skin on nape of neck hard, nodulous and rough ; habitual constipation ; in a woman past climacteric age.
Small of back aches, as if bruised or broken.
Pain in small of back, as if broken, especially on touching ; pressing, grasping and twitching, with sensation in arms and feet as if they were turned outward.
Tabes dorsalis, especially in women, with great weakness in legs and back, palpitation ;
dulness of sense ; numbness or torpor of genital organs and pains in chest. Contracting pains in back.
Weakness in back and loins on walking ; back aches.
Sacral pains, with sensation of crawling and stitching.
Numb pain, from sacrum down legs.
Dull drawing in coccyx in evening.
Pain in os coccygis while urinating.
Violent itching of coccygeal region, the part becoming moist with scurfy formations.
Shoulder and neck painful.
Tearing in left shoulder-joint, on moving arm.
Rheumatic or burning pains, especially in left shoulder.
Violent sticking in left shoulder.
Burning pressure beneath armpit.
Right upper arm sore, tender and swollen.
Arms feel ''asleep".
Jerking in arms.
Herpes circinatus hard to touch and wrinkled looking, itching terribly, in bend of elbow. Cramp in hand.
Tearing in hands like rheumatism.
Left hand numb and dead, with formication extending up arm.
Horny callosities in hands.
Skin of hands hard and cracked.
Eczema upon back of left hand ; commencing in a small place with vesicles ; spreads, forms crusts, and finally fissures, especially upon knuckles of first phalanges.
Gouty swellings of fingers ; in joints.
Raw, moist places between fingers.
Constant chafed soreness between fingers.
Pain in thumb-joint, as if sprained.
Rheumatic pressive tearing in first joint of right thumb.
Vesicle on little finger itches, suppurates and discharges much matter, with burning and sticking, which, like the suppuration, continues a long time.
Finger-nails black and rough, matrix inflamed, with soreness, throbbing and numbness, no suppuration ; < from water.
Finger-nails become thick.
Smarting soreness between nates.

Eruption over nates and posterior part of thighs ; no diffused redness, but numerous small, brown scabs, with slight moisture ; occasional paroxysms of itching ; troublesome at night ; some small, red, itching spots on arms.
Painful soreness between pudendum and thigh, covered with pimples, vesicles and ulcers. Red, raw spot like a tetter on upper part of thigh, opposite scrotum, itching somewhat in
morning.
Painful soreness between upper part of thighs near genitals.
Pains extending from pudenda to thighs.
Soreness high up between thighs, during and after walking.
Tearing or bruised pains in thighs.
Numbness of thighs.
Ulcers on lower limbs, with acrid pus, dryness of skin and constipation. Restlessness in legs.
Heaviness of legs.
Legs and feet heavy and swollen ; she thought her feet must burst.
Swelling of legs, even while lying in bed.
Great oedema of limbs, chiefly lower, which are very large, with profuse, constant, watery exudation from skin below knees, epidermis exfoliated. θ Ascites.
Bruised pain in knees.
Stiff feeling in hollow of knee, as if tendons were too short.
Tetters in hollow of knee.
Jerking in all the muscles of left calf.
Cramp in calves.
Weakness of feet, cannot walk.
Sometimes feet are icy-cold, again quite burning.
Cold feet in evening in bed.
Coldness of dorsum of foot.
Feet sweat profusely (not so offensive as under Silica), but moderate walking causes soreness between toes, so that the parts become raw.
Profuse sweat on feet ; they begin to smell.
Ulcers on feet, form purulent pustules, always inflamed and very painful. Callous ulcers of the feet.
(Edema pedum, with solitary itching papula ; erysipelatous redness of face ; menses scanty. (Edema pedum from amenorrhea.
Rheumatic tearing in feet and toes.
Burning of heels with crawling, especially in morning in bed.
Stitches in heel, when putting it down.
Gouty tearing in toes.
Stiffness and contraction of toes.
Ulcers, or spreading blisters on toes.
Horny skin on toes.
Sore pains of corns. θ Lung disease.
Thick and crippled toe-nails.
Hypertrophied nail of left big toe ; it was formed almost like a horn, and so hard, that only by repeated and long-continued operations with a file, it could be diminished. Pain in nail of great toe.
Ingrowing toe-nail.
Drawing pains in limbs.
Tearing pain in feet and hands ; in all the limbs.
Falling asleep of arms and legs while sitting ; while walking, crawling in them.
Limbs go "to sleep".
Weakness of all the limbs.
Startings of hands and feet.
Heaviness in limbs.
Paralyzed sensation of all the limbs.
Hands and feet either hot or cold.
Limbs drawn together, crooked, from bones being bent.

Back of both forearms and dorsum of hand covered with corroding, herpetic exanthema, consisting partly of a kind of cortical crusts, partly of red fissures, looking like raw meat, partly of elevated islets ; the exanthema was spreading and painfully itching, especially at night ; discharge of turbid matter and acrid water ; lips and skin of fingers fissured ; upper arm nearly free ; on lower extremities flexors are affected, and especially bend of knee and external surface, with same discharge and same burning itching, which becomes < when eruption is dry ; < during fall ; > during summer ; pale, slightly oedematous face ; sluggishness of all secretions and excretions ; spontaneous fissures in skin ; cannot bear damp atmosphere ; when a youth had measles, and in consequence of bathing too soon had paralysis of face ; mouth drawn sideways ; cannot close left eye, which looks smaller than right.

Eczema chronic on dorsal region of both forearms and hands, and on bends of knees and calves of legs ; eruption composed partly of thick crusts and partly of a raw surface, with deep rhagades, constantly secreting eczematous fluid ; intolerable itching, < at night and from warmth of bed ; lips chapped, fingers full of rhagades ; face pale, bloated ; bowels torpid, constipated ; all < in damp and wet.
Obliged to lie down : vertigo headache.
Pains in back compel her to stay in bed.
Inclination to sit down.
Lying in bed : swelling of legs, soreness from.
Lying down: > crampy, spasmodic, clawing pain in stomach ; on left hypochondrium, pain < ; anxiety and oppression of chest.
Lying on neck : causes pain.
Lying : on right side, pain in belly, in left ; lying upon left pain in right side. θ Between catamenial periods.
While sitting : falling asleep of arms and legs.
Sitting down : pain in hemorrhoids ; profuse leucorrhcea ; weakness of back.
Stooping : during and after, vertigo ; everything turns black before eyes ; saliva runs from mouth. Standing : < pain with heaviness of abdomen.
Looking upward : vertigo.
Putting down heel : causes stitches.
Bending neck : causes pain.
Stiffness on first beginning to move.
Motion : causes pain in thoracic muscles.
Motion during eating, talking, laughing or yawning : brings on attacks of convulsions of left side of body.
Every motion : < strong pulsation of blood ; causes sweat.
Least exertion : stitches in chest and palpitation of heart.
Rising : from bed feels as if drunken ; < crampy pain in stomach ; weight in abdomen. Moving jaw : cracking in ear.
Walking : eructations ; profuse leucorrhoea ; weakness in back and loins ; soreness high up between thighs during and after ; causes soreness between toes.
Every step makes reverberations in ear.
Reaching high with arms : pain in uterus.
Child throws itself back and straightens body.
Tremulous sensation through whole body.
Tired feeling ; lassitude ; inclination to sit down.
Amazingly weary and sleepy.
Debility, without pain, compelling him to groan.
Frequently feels faint, with partial loss of senses.

Pressive pain externally right of occiput, gradually extending to nape, throat and shoulder blades.
Severe stitches in occiput and both temples, as if plug or nail were being driven in.
Head bent backward, with swelling below larynx ; violent pulsation of carotids, rattling breathing.
Sensitiveness of scalp to touch, with burning and itching in morning after rising (after abuse of mercury).
Extreme sensitiveness of scalp, could hardly bear to comb her hair or have anything touch the head.
Disposed to take cold from uncovering head.
Burning itching on scalp, from forehead to occiput.
Nightly pain in skull bones.
Nodosities on head, sore to touch, > by covering head warmly and from sweat.
Painful tumors on head ; sebaceous tumors inflamed and ready to discharge.
Boils on head and neck, very sore on contact.
Falling off of hair, with very sore, painful pimples, and large bald spots on scalp.
Loss of hair following mercurialization or chronic headache.
Cold, clammy perspiration, smelling sour, principally on head and face, with aversion to being uncovered ; < from least exercise and during night ; > from warmth and when at rest.

Fissured eruption behind and on both ears, exuding a thick, gluey secretion, which mats hair ; resents with force on attempt to place finger on head ; utter abhorrence to be bathed, during which she would scream and fight.

Humid eruptions : feel sore ; of fetid odor ; itching violently on rising in morning ; burning and feeling sore on scratching ; scabs easily torn off, leaving a raw, bleeding surface. Favus, extending to nape of neck or face.
Photophobia.
Objects appear to be red.
Feeling of blindness before eyes on rising and standing up after sitting bent over.
Sight becomes dim when reading.
Eyes become dim, cannot see well in evening by candle light.

Anesthesia of retina, the result of looking at an eclipse ; sees a light spot in centre of field of vision, surrounded by a dark ring, and again by a lighter ring, all of which were constantly turning and changing into various colors, especially green ; < coming into room from bright sunlight ; feeling as if eyes were being pulled back into head, with photophobia ; vision 21/100 ; field of vision very much contracted.
Flickering before eyes ; pupils dilated and insensible to light ; after abuse of mercury. Inflammation of ciliary body.
Purulent capsulitis after extraction of cataract.
Prolapsus iridis.
Iritis with Hypopion or associated with small abscesses in iris (suppurative iritis).
Anterior chamber about half filled with pus ; eye sensitive to light and air, and must be covered ; no syphilitic origin. θ Iritis with Hypopion.

After injury to eye, violent inflammation ; sclerotica looks like raw beef ; light intolerable ; feeling as of sand in eye ; in anterior chamber a collection of pus apparently about two lines in diameter ; meditates suicide, especially in evening. θ Hypopion.
Onyx.

Cornea dim, opaque and bulging, with a blister-like elevation, as large as end of knitting needle, in centre, forming base of an open ulcer ; Hypopion ; fever with pressing, burning, bruised pain in eyes, extending into head. θ Hypopion.
For three months left cornea so hazy that iris could hardly be seen, and for two months right cornea had gradually become involved from periphery toward centre ; both cornez
opaque and vision lost ; considerable pain in eyes and head, with iritis ; great ciliary injection and excessive dread of light ; lachrymation ; no history of syphilis.

Severe inflammation in cornea and iris of left eye ; cornea ulcerated superficially, much ciliary injection, pupil contracted, iris sluggish, great photophobia and lachrymation, much pain extending from eye into corresponding side of head, < at night, especially about 2 or 3 A.M. ; seat of pain in head, as well as eye, quite sore to touch ; lids considerably swollen and slight discharge. θ Kerato-iritis.
Kerato-iritis with ulceration of cornea, Hypopion, sensitiveness to air and touch.

Ulcers and abscesses of cornea, especially for deep sloughing form and when Hypopion is present ; intense photophobia ; profuse lachrymation ; great redness of cornea and conjunctiva, even chemosis ; pains severe, of a throbbing, aching, stinging character ; > from warmth, so that he constantly wishes to keep eye covered ; < from any draught of air ; at night or in evening lids often swollen, spasmodically closed and very sensitive to touch, or may be red, swollen and bleed easily upon opening.
Sclerotic violet red, cornea dim ; great photophobia and lachrymation ; lower lids swollen. θ Ulceration of cornea.
Recurring ulceration of cornea in ophthalmia scrofulosa.
Torpid ulceration of cornea ; where there is a want of lachrymal secretion.
Red, vascular, elevated ulcer, like a piece of red flesh, at margin of cornea.
Opacities of cornea.
Acute aggravation of pannus, which tends toward ulceration, especially in mercurialized subjects.
Epithelioma of cornea.
Herpes conjunctivz bulbi ; enlarged veins, run nearly horizontally towards cornea, and terminating in little blisters near edge of cornea ; < from crying.
Eyes very red, great photophobia, lids red and swollen, with burning pain in affected parts. θ Ophthalmia.
Inflammation of eyes and lids ; sore to touch ; lachrymation.

Catarrhal inflammation and blenorrhea of eyes ; lids inflamed, excoriated, running, as if corroded, especially at inner canthus ; internal surface of lids, especially of lower, of deep red color and inflamed ; heat, especially in morning on waking ; pain, as of a burn, smarting, itching in lids ; lids and angles agglutinated in morning by purulent mucus ; conjunctiva red, traversed by large vessels ; photophobia ; in evening, vision of colored and dim halos around candle, with pressive pain forcing her to shut eyes occasionally. Inflammation of eye, small ulcer on left cornea ; eyeballs slightly swollen ; eyes closed by swelling at night, and discharging much purulent mucus ; hair fell off profusely, leaving bald places on scalp ; scabs on head, face and neck, painful when touched ; itching in
scalp ; frequent calls to stool, with difficult evacuations ; sour smelling sweat at night ; peevish, fretful humor.

Violent pain over right eyebrow ; excessive lachrymation of 1. eye ; photophobia alternating with unusually clear and distinct vision in dark part of room ; everything appearing illuminated ; at times objects appeared red ; left pupil much dilated, not sensitive even to strong light ; r. pupil normal ; conjunctiva reddened from canthi, but not on cornea ; sensation as if eyes projected ; painful pressure in eyeball as if bruised ; acute bruised pain on slightest touch. θ Foreign body in eye.
Purulent conjunctivitis with profuse discharge and excessive sensitiveness to air and touch.
Catarrhal conjunctivitis after inflammatory stage has passed.
Scrofulous inflammation of eyes, especially in phlegmatic, fat, large bellied children, with fine white skin, light hair, thick neck and swollen glands, subject to eruptions and ulcerations of skin.

Chronic inflammation of eyes, with | great —— iecabarwsniii nia mucous discharge ; formation of ulc ing, a re bruised. Symptomatic forms of chronic catarrh of c coe with satavetion of Meibomian glands and purulent secretion, in scrofulous subjects.

Eyeballs sore to touch ; ; pain as if they would be drawn back into head. Pressing pain in eyeballs, feel bruised when touched. Pressure in eyes as from sand.
